instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: Ryan claimed that the giraffe stole his food, but the evidence was not sufficient to warrant a free snack from the zoo.
atoms.b: Ryan claimed that the giraffe stole his food, but the evidence was not ((sufficient)) to warrant a free snack from the zoo.

atoms.a: Richard was struggling to stay awake during class.
atoms.b: Richard was ((struggling)) to stay awake during class.

atoms.a: He claims to be a millionaire, but is he really?
atoms.b: He claims to be a ((millionaire)), but is he really?

atoms.a: For the owner, it is not irrelevant who feeds their dog, because strangers could give them unhealthy or even poisonous snacks.
atoms.b: For the owner, it is not ((irrelevant)) who feeds their dog, because strangers could give them unhealthy or even poisonous snacks.

atoms.a: I get the impression that my sister is very busy because she is always checking her watch.
atoms.b: I get the ((impression)) that my sister is very busy because she is always checking her watch.

atoms.a: People working in restaurants need very good hand-eye coordination.
atoms.b: People working in restaurants need very good hand-eye ((coordination)).

atoms.a: She had not been happy in her first marriage and decided to get a divorce.
atoms.b: She had not been happy in her first ((marriage)) and decided to get a divorce.

atoms.a: Mr Ferget probably took the scissors and forgot to return them.
atoms.b: Mr Ferget probably took the ((scissors)) and forgot to return them.

parentBlock.title: Spelling Practice (7) - sufficient, struggling, millionaire, irrelevant, impression, coordination, marriage, scissors
